flows.name: edit-avatar-standalone
flows.description: The change badge on your own profile picture goes straight to the crop and its own seal — one signature, the picture alone.
steps: start · Profile · 4 «avatar change badge» → AvatarCrop — the system picker, then the crop — the standalone shortcut
AvatarCrop · 3 «Next» → AvatarSeal — the standalone change off the profile badge — its own seal
end · AvatarSeal · 4 «Sign the change» → back — signed — shown everywhere you appear

flows.name: edit-avatar-via-edit-screen
flows.description: Changing the picture from the edit screen returns to it — one seal covers the picture and the fields together.
steps: start · Profile · 6 «Edit profile» → ProfileEdit
ProfileEdit · 2 «Change picture» → AvatarCrop — the system picker, then the crop — Next returns here; one seal covers everything
AvatarCrop · 3 «Next» → ProfileEdit — come from the edit screen — the edit's one seal signs it
ProfileEdit · 6 «Save» → ProfileEditSeal
end · ProfileEditSeal · 4 «Sign the change» → back — signed — the profile updates

flows.name: narrow-the-feed
flows.description: The band's filter trigger opens the sheet, the sheet narrows the feed, and the reader opens a thread on what survives.
steps: start · Feed · 1 «Posts (filter chip)» → FeedSheet
FeedSheet · 6 «scrim — tap outside» → FeedNarrowed — narrowed
end · FeedNarrowed · 10 «comment count» → ReplyEntry

flows.name: sign-in
flows.description: Email and password on the sign-in screen land a member with their key on this device in their own feed.
steps: start · SignIn
end · SignIn · 6 «Sign in» → Feed — member, key on this device

flows.name: reply-to-a-post
flows.description: A post's comment count opens the thread sheet, Add a comment opens the composer, and the seal signs the reply back into the thread.

ReplyCompose · 3 «Next» → ReplySeal
end · ReplySeal · 9 «Sign comment» → ReplyEntry — signed — the thread, the comment settling
